page.layout: One page of index in two columns, left and right, under the title INDEX. Left column: Theodatus to Vrbanus primus, with the letter V. Right column: Vrbanus secundus to Zozimus secundus, with the letter Z, ending with FINIS. Each column is read top to bottom. No page number, running head or catchword is printed.
page.head: INDEX.
page.notes: The page numbers in the right-hand column are set in a different, slightly worn type, and the numerals 65, 31 and 80 are uncertain. The "Vrbanus" entries use a decorative capital V. The page is stained and creased, but all the printed lines are legible.
